Files taken unchanged from the package: `files/roboto-latin-300-normal.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-400-normal.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-400-italic.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-700-normal.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-ext-300-normal.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-ext-400-normal.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-ext-400-italic.woff2`, `files/roboto-latin-ext-700-normal.woff2`, `LICENSE`. Their SHA-256 hashes are in
[`SHA256SUMS`](SHA256SUMS), checked by the R13 test. Roboto, the design system's typeface, served from the site itself so that no visitor's browser contacts a font service (decision D5 in docs/ui-requirements.md). Latin and Latin Extended subsets, in the weights the design system uses. The @font-face rules are in static/fonts.css.

Refresh with `python tools/vendor.py roboto 5.3.0`.
